verdict.rationale: BVNK documents fiat payout APIs (first- and third-party bank payouts), virtual accounts in USD/EUR/GBP, and broad reach claims of sending/receiving/converting across 130+ countries, directly supporting stablecoin-to-fiat off-ramp for recipients. Missing for 10: a single published, granular table mapping supported countries to specific payout currencies/rails (only USD/EUR/GBP virtual accounts and a generic '130+ countries' claim are given), and independent/hands-on verification of real-world payout success across those geographies.
